decision: Reject unpacked MKL provider; packed microbenchmarks show mixed gains and have not established whole-model speed or parity. Continue with fused MLP eager operation.
library: PyTorch-bundled MKL 2024.2; diagnostic only, not a production dependency
micro: 5 warmups,15 measured calls per mode, alternating order, synthetic F32 matrices. OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE on repeat/packed tests.
model: 5 warmups,15 measured calls; original upstream Python, Rust production cached-tenferro and rejected unpacked provider; sequential processes, actual checkpoint.
accuracy: Synthetic GEMM max absolute errors below 5e-7. Full-model diagnostic parity is not established for the rejected provider.
reproduce: Apply unpacked_prototype.patch at base revision; point LAYA_MKL_DIAGNOSTIC_LIBRARY to a compatible supplied library, set its dependency search path, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8 and OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE. Run bench_laya_tenferro_gap with local checkpoint, warmup5, iterations15. Library/checkpoint paths are deliberately omitted.
